question: Should ClickClack adopt author-only editing for already-sent channel messages and thread replies as a supported core interaction?
rationale: The patch is an additive user-facing capability over an existing update endpoint; source-level review cannot determine whether its interaction, moderation expectations, and permanence fit the product without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow editing interaction
options.body: Approve author-only editing, then require a rebase onto current main and exact-head browser validation before merge.

options.title: Decline core message editing
options.body: Close the PR as an unsponsored product direction if immutable messages remain the intended ClickClack interaction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow editing interaction
recommendation.body: Approve author-only editing, then require a rebase onto current main and exact-head browser validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available implementation-specific contact, though current-main ownership history was not available in the supplied context.
